The European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) has determined that some population groups have a high risk of consuming too much E621 - Monosodium glutamate.

Groups with more than 50% of members exceeding the maximum dose without adverse effect (No observed adverse effect level - NOAEL): Toddlers, Children

Groups with more than 50% of members exceeding the acceptable daily intake (ADI): Infants, Toddlers, Children, Adolescents, Adults

Groups with more than 5% of members exceeding the maximum dose without adverse effect (No observed adverse effect level - NOAEL): Infants, Toddlers, Children, Adolescents

Groups with more than 5% of members exceeding the acceptable daily intake (ADI): Infants, Toddlers, Children, Adolescents, Adults, Elderly

Re‐evaluation of glutamic acid -E 620-, sodium glutamate -E 621-, potassium glutamate -E 622-, calcium glutamate -E 623-, ammonium glutamate -E 624- and magnesium glutamate -E 625- as food additives (2017/07/12)
